description: This file defines a sidebar component for a note management system, utilizing Qwik framework. It manages filtering notes by tags and folders, displaying tags and folders dynamically based on notes data, and providing UI elements for user interaction.

methods.name: component$
methods.description: Defines a Qwik component for the sidebar, handling note filtering UI.

methods.name: setTag$
methods.description: Setter function to update the selected tag in context.

methods.name: setFolder$
methods.description: Setter function to update the selected folder in context.
